case: domain-over-enum array_cat infers text and SQL NULL array parameters
outcome: PostgreSQL infers the qualified enum-array type for text and SQL NULL parameters passed to array_cat with a domain-over-enum source, even when a same-named shadow enum is first in search_path.
contract: Creates a domain over a custom enum and a same-named shadow enum with incompatible labels earlier in transaction search_path.
Uses text array parameters containing SQL NULL elements, empty strings, the literal label NULL, commas, quotes, and backslashes; also covers empty arrays and a SQL NULL array parameter.
Compares array_cat values against native explicitly typed array expressions and checks pg_typeof for the parameter and result.
